name: Hunting Knife
body:
Price 21,308 gp; Slot none; CL 7th; Weight 2 lbs.; Aura moderate divination

DESCRIPTION

This +1 huntsman tracking kukri is used by hunting parties to take down prey. When the wielder uses the hunting bond (companion) ability to share their favored enemy with their allies, they also share the benefit of the weapon’s huntsman property with those allies. Sharing the property lasts as long as the hunting bond ability persists. Allies can deal extra damage with the huntsman property as long as the wielder of the hunting knife tracked the shared target in the past 24 hours.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 10,808 gp Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells know the enemy
